description: Image Description: The image shows a park scene with a paved pathway running through it. To the left of the pathway is a grassy area with a few people walking in the distance. In the foreground, there is a tall post with a "No Cycling" sign attached to it. The sign features an image of a bicycle with a red circle and a diagonal line through it, indicating that cycling is prohibited. Trees with green leaves are visible on both sides of the pathway. The sky is partly cloudy,
